mainEntity.name: How does an AI Search audit differ from a traditional SEO audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a traditional SEO audit focuses on keyword rankings, backlinks, and technical factors for human-driven search, an AI Search audit emphasizes semantic understanding, structured data, and content clarity for AI algorithms. It examines how well your content answers user queries directly and comprehensively, providing context that AI can leverage for generative answers. Key differences include a stronger focus on entity recognition, knowledge graph integration, and ensuring your content is factually accurate and well-supported, which are crucial for AI model confidence.
acceptedAnswer.description: An AI Search audit focuses on semantic understanding and structured data for AI algorithms, while traditional SEO targets keyword rankings and backlinks for human search.
